faq.a1: Select a service, submit the request form, and pay the deposit after coach confirmation to lock the slot.
faq.a2: WeChat Pay and Alipay. Stripe for international clients (coming soon).
faq.a3: Full refund if cancelled more than 24 hours before the session; within 24 hours, 50% of the deposit is retained.

faq.a6: Paid slots can be rescheduled once for free up to 12 hours before the session, subject to coach availability.

intro.tip1: Use your gaming mouse and in-game DPI settings — the full test takes about 5 minutes

mouse_control.hint: Keep your crosshair inside the moving red target for 20 seconds

left_precision.hint: When a target appears, flick left and click it — 8 trials

right_precision.hint: When a target appears, flick right and click it — 8 trials

reaction.hint: Click the moment the panel turns gold — 5 trials

ergonomics.fatigue: Hand fatigue after long sessions (1 none - 5 severe)

report.title: Assessment Report
report.analysis: Your strongest dimension is "{strongest}" and your weakest is "{weakest}". Keep your strengths sharp while prioritizing targeted work on the weak area.
report.advice_mouse_control: Do 15 minutes of tracking-based aim training daily (smooth tracking drills), focusing on crosshair stability and stop accuracy.
report.advice_left_precision: Add wide-angle left-flick drills and pre-aim routines to build left-side muscle memory.
report.advice_right_precision: Add wide-angle right-flick drills and pre-aim routines to build right-side muscle memory.
report.advice_ergonomics: Tune DPI/sensitivity into the mainstream range, stretch your hands between sessions, and consider a mouse or grip change if fatigue persists.
report.advice_reaction: Reduce reliance on raw reactions through pre-aiming and positioning, plus dedicated reaction drills (e.g. Aim Lab reaction modes).

coach.name: Coach WineCellar
coach.title: Professional CS2 Esports Coach
coach.bio1: Over a decade in the Counter-Strike franchise — from player to coach — leading academy and semi-pro teams, and specializing in breaking complex tactical systems down into executable individual training plans.
coach.bio2: A firm believer that talent can be measured and growth can be tracked, he built his own talent assessment system and player data tracking methodology to help every student see exactly where they stand and what comes next.
coach.point1: 10+ years in the CS franchise, 5 years coaching
coach.point2: 40+ players coached, 12 signed to pro academy systems
coach.point3: Original talent assessment covering precision, control, reaction and comfort
coach.point4: Bilingual coaching in Chinese and English
